parsed.note_claim: Europeans have been using soap for thousands of years, long before the Moors colonized parts of Europe.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The Romans avoided washing with harsh soaps before encountering the milder soaps used by the Gauls c. 58 BC
parsed.reason: The text confirms Gauls (Europeans) used soap in 58 BC, substantiating the claim of soap use for thousands of years prior to the Moorish colonization.
